name: Cagrilintide
description: Experimental long-acting version of amylin, a pancreas hormone; tested alone and with semaglutide

note.text: CagriSema pairs cagrilintide with semaglutide 2.4 mg. A Phase 3 trial of cagrilintide alone (RENEW 1) is still running.

bullets: **Long-acting version** of amylin, a hormone the pancreas releases
**Given once a week** under the skin in trials
**No FDA label,** so there is no approved mechanism statement
Phase 3 of cagrilintide alone still running

practical.routes: Injection under the skin, once weekly (trials)
practical.pharmacokinetics: Exposure rose in proportion to dose (Phase 1)
practical.soldAs: Not approved; FDA says it cannot be compounded
practical.monitored: Body weight, HbA1c, stomach and bowel effects
practical.sport: Not named on the 2026 list; S0 status unconfirmed

regulatory.text: Not approved; cannot be used in compounding
Not named; class S0 may apply

references: Lau et al., cagrilintide Phase 2, Lancet, Dec 2021
Garvey et al., REDEFINE 1, N Engl J Med, Aug 2025
FDA, Concerns with unapproved GLP-1 drugs used for weight loss, Oct 2026
